policy: A local code check is not a target-environment POC pass.

pocs.name: audio attacks
pocs.threshold: target audio formats, ASR, timeline and block evidence pass

pocs.name: video attacks
pocs.threshold: frame and audio timeline joint decision passes

pocs.name: image and text collaborative attack
pocs.threshold: single modalities benign and fused intent blocked

pocs.name: custom keyword and regular expression
pocs.command: pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.config.mts --run tests/guard-engine-v2 tests/detection/safe-regex.test.ts
pocs.threshold: new rule takes effect through approved bundle

pocs.name: context-aware business allow rule
pocs.threshold: benign insurance context passes while mandatory attacks remain blocked

pocs.name: alerts and 180-day conversation query
pocs.command: pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.config.mts --run tests/data-protection tests/api-security
pocs.threshold: target database contains and queries approved 180-day fixture

pocs.name: evidence and end-to-end trace reconstruction
pocs.command: pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.config.mts --run tests/observability tests/multimodal tests/media
pocs.threshold: one trace reconstructs gateway, detector, RAG/tool and model chronology

pocs.name: operations inspection
pocs.threshold: CPU, memory, storage, accelerator and service state visible

pocs.name: multi-role authorization isolation
pocs.command: pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.config.mts --run tests/auth tests/tenancy tests/api-security
pocs.threshold: three administrators and data scopes cannot exceed authority

pocs.name: containerized deployment
pocs.threshold: target Kubernetes install, scale and uninstall succeed

pocs.name: high availability
pocs.threshold: fault injection recovers without bypass and meets RPO/RTO
